description: OneMap Singapore is a geoportal run by Singapore Land Authority. OneMap is the national map service with search, routing and thematic layers for public facilities and services in Singapore, and a developer API for geocoding, routing and themes. Coverage: Singapore. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as api, json; access is free of charge; the API needs a free account token.
